Multiplying the numerator by the conjugate $1-2i$:
$(-3+4i)(1-2i) = -3 + 6i + 4i - 8i^2 = -3 + 10i + 8 = 5 + 10i$

The denominator is $(1+2i)(1-2i) = 1 - 4i^2 = 5$.

So $\frac{-3+4i}{1+2i} = \frac{5+10i}{5} = 1+2i$.

Check: $(1+2i)(1+2i) = 1 + 4i + 4i^2 = -3 + 4i$, which matches the original numerator.
